items.title: MAC Honors Burch and Davis
items.summary: BUFFALO, NY – University at Buffalo running back Messiah Burch and safety Ronnell Davis were named the Mid-American Conference Offensive and Defensive Player of the Week, respectively, the league announced on Monday.

items.title: Bulls Grill Central Michigan, 40-21
items.summary: BUFFALO, NY – The University at Buffalo football team produced their best offensive performance of the season to beat Central Michigan, 40-21, at Broadview Stadium on Wednesday night. It was the Bulls sixth straight win and kept them tied for first place in the Mid-American Conference standings.

items.title: Burch Named MAC Offensive Player of the Week
items.summary: BUFFALO, NY – Following his career performance against Ball State, University at Buffalo running back Messiah Burch was named the Mid-American Conference Offensive Player of the Week, the league announced on Monday. It marked the second time this season he has won the award.

Bulls Host Central Michigan in Home Finale on Wednesday
items.summary: Buffalo (7-3, 5-1 MAC) vs. Central Michigan (5-5, 3-3 MAC)

items.title: Bulls Surge Past Ball State for Fifth Straight Win
items.summary: MUNCIE, IN – On a rainy night in Muncie, IN, the University at Buffalo football team relied on a steady dose of the run game to pull away from Ball State, 28-7, and secure their fifth straight win. The Bulls improved to 5-1 in Mid-American Conference play and stayed tied atop the league standings.

items.title: Morrow Named MAC Co-Offensive Player of the Week
items.summary: BUFFALO, NY – University at Buffalo wide receiver Chance Morrow was named the Mid-American Conference Co-Offensive Player of the Week, the league announced on Monday. He shared the award with UMass quarterback Pop Watson.

items.title: Bulls Clip RedHawks in Overtime, 34-31
items.summary: OXFORD, OH – The University at Buffalo football team rallied from a 15-point fourth quarter deficit to beat Miami (OH), 34-31, in overtime at Yager Stadium on Tuesday night. Miami's field goal attempt to tie the game in overtime bounced off the right upright, allowing the Bulls to win their fourth straight game.
